_meta.note: Token estimates are raw userQuery+pipelineContent chars/4. Actual LLM consumption is 3-10x higher due to system prompts, hydrated DB context, and conversation history.

1.name: Foundations
1.description: Basic agent loop (controller -> specialist -> reviewer), simple tool invocations, text-only responses. No seeded data, no DB assertions. Validates that the core agent conversation engine works.

2.name: Tools & Single Agents
2.description: V2 schema with MongoDB/HTTP assertions, individual specialist agents (objective, plan, checklist, reconcile, resource), multi-step tool chains, seeded data. Validates each agent and tool in isolation with verified outcomes.

3.name: Pipelines & Multi-Agent
3.description: Intake pipelines (triage + generalist hydration), multi-agent orchestration, re-intake deduplication, file upload, thread merge, generalist multi-tool sessions. Validates agent chaining and pipeline phases 0-2.

4.name: E2E Stories & Context Assembly
4.description: Full 7-phase intake pipelines, multi-source alignment, scheduled/on-demand agents, ask-claw context assembly with testPrompts verification. Validates the complete system end-to-end.
